title: INAB: identify nucleic acid binding domain via cross-modal protein language models and multiscale computation.
authors: Zhang, Jun; Zeng, Hao; Chen, Junjie; Zhu, Zexuan
one_liner_zh: 该文利用跨模态蛋白语言模型和多尺度计算预测核酸结合结构域，属于广义蛋白-核酸互作识别，方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合位点预测，但未聚焦TF-DNA特异性结合机制。
abstract: Protein-nucleic acid interactions play a crucial role in biological processes, including gene regulation and editing. Accurately identifying nucleic acid-binding domains in proteins is essential to unravel these interactions, yet traditional experimental methods like X-ray crystallography remain costly and time-intensive. Computational approaches have thus emerged as indispensable tools to complement wet-lab techniques. Here, we introduce a framework for nucleic acid-binding domain prediction by integrating cross-modal protein language models with a multiscale computational architecture. The proposed method leverages a structurally annotated benchmark dataset, which quantifies binding likelihood through hierarchical, proximity-based labels derived from experimental complexes. Evaluations demonstrate that the approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, providing a new insight into the design of multimodal learning systems in protein-nucleic acid interaction analysis and an open resource to accelerate discoveries in functional genomics and drug design.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质-核酸相互作用在生物过程中扮演着关键角色，包括基因调控和编辑。准确识别蛋白质中的核酸结合结构域对于揭示这些相互作用至关重要，然而传统的实验方法如X射线晶体学（X-ray crystallography）仍然成本高昂且耗时。因此，计算方法已成为补充湿实验技术不可或缺的工具。在此，我们介绍一个通过整合跨模态蛋白质语言模型（cross-modal protein language models）与多尺度计算架构（multiscale computational architecture）的核酸结合结构域预测框架。所提出的方法利用一个结构注释的基准数据集，该数据集通过源自实验复合物的层次化、基于邻近性的标签来量化结合可能性。评估表明，该方法达到了最先进的性能，为蛋白质-核酸相互作用分析中多模态学习系统的设计提供了新见解，并作为开放资源加速功能基因组学和药物设计的发现。
